verdict.rationale: Galileo's metrics docs say users can extend the built-in metrics with custom metrics, explicitly including "Code-based metrics" and "Composite code-based metrics." Experiments evaluate applications "against metrics of your choice," and custom metrics can be scoped globally or to specific projects. missing for 10: detailed docs or SDK examples showing how to author a code-based scorer (function signature, inputs/outputs, registration), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations

citations.quote: You can then expand these metrics with custom metrics, using LLM-as-a-judge, or custom code-based metrics.
Experiments allow you to evaluate prompts, models, and your application code, using well-defined inputs, against metrics of your choice.
Choose whether a metric is global and available in every project, or project-scoped and available in selected projects.
